buidls.name: Elephant Tracks
buidls.vision: Every DEX flow tool reduces the tape to one signed number, and that number cannot tell one desk selling into a crowd from a thousand matched pairs. Elephant Tracks makes the shape of flow readable from data anyone can already fetch.

buidls.name: TrendLab Market Structure Map

buidls.name: Crypto Derivatives Risk Radar

buidls.name: CMC Market Detective
buidls.vision: An AI market detective powered by CoinMarketCap: detect unusual moves, investigate the evidence, compare market context, find similar setups, and generate grounded explanations—without inventing catalysts or predictions.
buidls.team_description:
I am a solo builder working across AI, crypto, Web3, and product development.

I built CMC Market Detective independently for the CoinMarketCap API Hackathon, taking the project from idea and system design to implementation and final demo.

I developed the CoinMarketCap data integration, anomaly detection logic, investigation workflow, relative market analysis, behavioral similarity engine, AI explanation layer, and user interface.

The project explores how market APIs can become more useful when combined with deterministic analytics and evidence-grounded AI.

Rather than asking AI to guess what happened, Market Detective first calculates what the data actually shows and then uses AI to explain it.
